title: Kospi Index Affected by AI Sell-Off and Chip Stock Decline
description: The KOSPI index, representing the South Korean stock market, has been significantly impacted by a sell-off in AI and chip stocks, leading to a three-month low.

sources.title: Asian technology stocks extend sell-off with SoftBank down 7% as AI plays take a hit

sections.heading: Kospi Index Overview
paragraphs: The KOSPI index, which tracks the performance of the South Korean stock market, has recently experienced a downturn. This decline is attributed to a broader sell-off in AI and chip stocks, as reported by various news outlets.

sections.heading: Impact of AI Sell-Off
paragraphs: According to CNBC, Asian technology stocks, including SoftBank, have extended their sell-off with a 7% decline, as AI-related stocks take a hit. This trend is part of a larger pattern affecting the KOSPI index.
The Guardian reports that the South Korean stock market is at a three-month low due to the intensifying AI sell-off, which includes chip stocks such as SK Hynix and Samsung.

sections.heading: Chip Stock Decline
paragraphs: BBC highlights that chip stocks are sliding in both the US and Asia, with investors becoming increasingly jittery about AI. This decline is directly impacting the KOSPI index, which includes several major chip manufacturers.

faq.a: The KOSPI index is a stock market index representing the performance of the South Korean stock market.

faq.q: Why is the KOSPI index declining?
faq.a: The KOSPI index is declining due to a sell-off in AI and chip stocks, as reported by CNBC, BBC, and The Guardian.
According to the news coverage, stocks such as SoftBank, SK Hynix, and Samsung are among those most affected by the AI sell-off and chip stock decline.
